title: McDonald's Fry Timer Beep
blurb: The McDonald's fry timer — the relentless beeping that haunts every fast-food kitchen and, through sheer cultural osmosis, everyone else too. It means the fries are ready and nobody is coming. Play it as an alarm, a prank, or a tribute to anyone who's ever worked a fryer station. The beep does not stop. The beep never stops.
origin: The infamous fry-timer beep from McDonald's kitchens.
